description: P28: the Iron Regiment's battle (battle.iron_regiment), in its own frame (a march at 112 BPM in D minor, twelve bars, 25.7 s; it shares no stem with the zone sets): march drums - a bass drum, snares, rolls and cymbals - and a brass theme; from phase 2 fifes and high trumpets. Enters after its one-bar intro stinger.
